content: Replicated Troubleshoot support-bundle pipeline is collect → redact → analyze. Analyzers are YAML-defined criteria over collected data producing ordered pass/warn/fail outcomes with messages (and optional uri). Docs explicitly frame support-bundle analyzers as surfacing known issues or hints to make troubleshooting easier—not a full SRE co-pilot. Defaults include collectors/analyzers/redactors; vendor portal and KOTS add SaaS/in-cluster UI; sbctl helps kubectl-style offline bundle interaction. Host collectors/analyzers cover down-cluster cases.
